test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
solution:
**Given:**

Number of girls with height ≤ 125 cm = 43

Number of girls with height ≤ 135 cm = 68

**Formula Used:**

Number of girls with height > 125 cm = Number of girls with height ≤ 135 cm - Number of girls with height ≤ 125 cm

**Calculation:**

Number of girls with height > 125 cm = 68 - 43

**∴ Number of girls with height > 125 cm = 25**
